postings.title: 5G CN & Network Senior Engineer - IRIS2
postings.description:
Hispasat, as part of the SpaceRISE consortium, is responsible for the technical implementation and ensuring the success of the IRIS² project, leveraging its extensive experience in satellite communications. This collaboration is essential to provide secure and reliable high-performance communication solutions to the European Union and its member states.

To be part of this project, we are looking for 5G CN & Network Senior Engineer. The responsibilities of the position are as follows:
Responsibilities

- Define 5G Core Network requirements for the IRIS² multi-orbit satellite system.

- Define the high-level hardware and software architecture of the 5G Core Network and associated network functions and interfaces.

- Define implementation, integration and test plans for the proposed 5G Core and network subsystems.

- Perform the technical follow-up of subcontractor activities related to design, requirements compliance, development and validation.

- Support higher-level integration of 5G Core and network subsystems into the Ground Segment and end-to-end service architecture.

- Support architectural trade-offs for the integration of satellite and terrestrial 5G networks, including control-plane and user-plane connectivity.

- Master's Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

- 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in telecommunications networks.

- Strong knowledge of mobile-network architecture, including Core Network, RAN and auxiliary services.

- Experience with 5G Core architecture and the implementation or integration of 3GPP Core Network functions.

- Expert knowledge of terrestrial 3GPP standards and familiarity with 3GPP NTN evolution.

- Experience with resource allocation, service orchestration and control-plane interfaces.

- Experience in the development, integration and testing of 4G or 5G systems.

- Knowledge of virtualisation, NFV, SDN and cloud platforms.

- Knowledge of cloud-native network functions, containers and orchestration is considered an asset.

- Knowledge of satellite communications and satellite-terrestrial network integration.

- Experience in managing or technically coordinating technology projects.

- Nationality of an EU Member State and willingness to undergo an EU Secret clearance process.

postings.title: Classified Information Management Support - IRIS2
postings.description:
Hispasat, as part of the SpaceRISE consortium, is responsible for the technical implementation and for ensuring the success of the IRIS² project, leveraging its extensive experience in satellite communications. This collaboration is essential to provide secure, reliable and high-performance communication solutions to the European Union and its Member States.

To be part of this project, we are looking for a Classified Information Management Support professional. The responsibilities of the position are as follows:

Position Mission

The main purpose of this position is to protect, control, and manage the entire lifecycle of classified information associated with the IRIS² Project (hereinafter, the “Project”), ensuring strict compliance with applicable security regulations and company standards.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Marking and Classification: Ensure the proper marking, classification, reclassification, and declassification of documents according to the applicable classification level, the criteria established by the National Security Office (ONS), and the Project’s security instructions.

- Mandatory Document Control: Register, classify, archive, and ensure the traceability of the receipt, dispatch, and distribution of physical and digital documentation subject to security requirements.

- Secure Storage Management: Manage and maintain up-to-date records of safes, security cabinets, and accredited rooms where the Project’s classified information is stored.

- Inventories and Audit Support: Ensure that the inventory of the Project’s classified information assets is kept up to date and provide support, when required, during internal and external security audits affecting the area of responsibility.

- Secure Logistics and Destruction: Support the management of classified information exchanges and coordinate the secure dispatch and receipt of classified information within the Project, including exchanges with official bodies, other consortium members, partners, and other relevant stakeholders. Carry out the certified destruction of obsolete material.

- Systems and Tools Maintenance: Administer and update restricted digital repositories and document management systems in accordance with strict encryption and access permission requirements.

Candidate Requirements

- Education: Higher Vocational Training qualification or University Degree in Document Management or a related field.

- Security Clearance (Critical Requirement): Must hold a valid Personnel Security Clearance (HSP) at a classification level equal to or higher than that required by the Project, issued by the National Security Office (ONS).

- Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in Document Control, confidential records management, or administrative support roles within the Defence, Aerospace, Public Sector, or Critical Infrastructure sectors.

- Technical Knowledge:

- Advanced use of document management tools.

- Familiarity with regulations governing the management of classified information.

- Experience implementing document traceability and audit mechanisms.

- Knowledge of document management regulations, procedures, and best practices.

- Basic knowledge of encryption tools.

- Experience in process optimisation and continuous improvement related to information management.

- Languages: Native or bilingual Spanish. Fluent English, with a minimum B2 level, both written and spoken, for handling international documentation and regulations.

Desired Competencies

- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

- Strong sense of ethics, integrity, and professional discretion.

- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to work methodically under pressure.

- Clear and assertive communication skills, particularly when applying and enforcing security requirements within the organisation.
